source: 664 Confirming the Boundary
target: 664: Fines Confirmans

source: Lumian’s gaze fixated on the golden pocket watch, his suspicions heightened by the peculiar scent in the air.
target: Aspectus Lumiani in aureum horologium portatile fixus est, cum suspicionibus ejus a singulari odore in aere excitatis.

source: He felt as though he had slumbered for more than an hour.
target: Sentiit se quasi plus quam unam horam dormivisse.

source: Why then had only seven minutes elapsed?
target: Cur ergo tantum septem minuta praeterierunt?

source: Though the unreliability of his instincts were plausible, other anomalies lurked.
target: Quamquam infirmitas instinctuum eius plausibilis videbatur, alia anomalia latuerunt.

source: The absence of mosquito corpses and the eerie silence hinted at peculiarities.
target: Absentia cadaverum culicum et silentium horribile indicia peculiaria suggerebat.

source: Lumian, drawing from his past encounters, murmured to himself, Could it be that I’ve entered a special dream?
target: Lumian, ex praeteritis congressionibus inspiratus, sibi submurmuravit: “Numquid fortasse in somnium speciale intravi?”

source: In the dead of night, slumbering within this tawny house leads to a peculiar dream?
target: In media nocte, obdormire in hac domo fulva ad somnium peculiare ducit?

source: Did “Hisoka” Twanaku rebuild the house to make it look less suspicious for him to stay there?
target: Num “Hisoka” Twanaku domum refecit ut minus suspecta appareret ad eum manendum?

source: But why would such a thing happen?
target: Sed cur talis res evenire possit?

source: Lumian bowed his head and peered ahead.
target: Lumian caput inclinavit et ante oculis spectavit.

source: His gaze seemed to penetrate through wooden planks and various obstacles, revealing the corresponding underground area.
target: Aspectus eius per tabulas ligneas et diversa impedimenta penetrare videbatur, regionem subterraneam cognatam revelans.

source: Uncertain about the origin of this anomaly, he could only speculate based on common sense and experience.
target: Nescit unde haec anomalia oritur, ergo solum ex sensu communi et experientia coniectari potuit.

source: In the silent darkness, Lumian shuffled his feet, producing creaking sounds as he left the house that once belonged to “Hisoka” Twanaku.
target: In silentio obscuro, Lumian pedes labefaciens sonos stridulos edere fecit, dum domum quae olim “Hisoka” Twanaku pertinebat relinquebat.

source: The street lay deserted, and many of the livestock on the ground floor of the buildings seemed to blend into the night.
target: Via deserta iacebat, et plura pecora in plano aedificiorum in nocte coalescere videbantur.

source: It was impossible to discern if they still existed.
target: Non licuit discernere utrum adhuc exstiterint.

source: The footsteps of patrolling soldiers had vanished completely.
target: Vestigia militum speculatorum omnino evanuerant.

source: A warm, humid night breeze swept through the unobstructed streets, surrounding Lumian as he headed towards the entrance of the Giant Boa bar.
target: Aura calida et umida nocturna per vias expensas vehebatur, in circuitu Lumiani, dum ad ostium tabernae “Giant Boa” se dirigebat.

source: Straining his ears, Lumian noticed that it was so quiet that even the rustling of insects and the buzzing of mosquitoes had ceased.
target: Aures intendens, Lumian animadvertit tam quietum esse ut etiam murmur insectorum et zumus culicum cessaverit.

source: His expression remained unchanged as he extended his right hand, pushing open the heavy wooden door.
target: Vultus eius immotis manebat, dum dextram manum extendit et ianuam ligneam gravem aperiebat.

source: Darkness shrouded the interior.
target: Interior obscuritate involutum erat.

source: With the dim moonlight filtering through the window and Lumian’s sharp eyesight as a Hunter, he could barely discern the outlines of the bar counter, liquor cabinet, small round table, chairs, candlestick wall lamps, and other items, but not a single human was in sight.
target: Luna pallida per fenestram effluens et acuta vigilantia Lumiani ut Venatoris vix sinit distinguere figuram mensae popinae, armarii liquorarii, mensae parvae rotundae, sellarum, lampadarum parietalium, ceteraque, sed neque unus homo apparebat.

source: The bar seemed to have been closed for quite some time.
target: Taberna diutius clausa videbatur.

source: This is even more perplexing.
target: Hoc etiam magis perplexum est.

source: Before I fell asleep, this bar was quite lively.
target: Antequam obdormirem, haec taberna valde animata erat.

source: It’s impossible for them to clear out the customers and clean every corner in seven to eight minutes.
target: Impossibile est ut clientes expellent et omnia angula in septem ad octo minutis purgantur.

source: Based on my experience, even though countryside bars close earlier than those in the city and aren’t bustling until two or three in the morning, they usually continue selling alcohol until midnight.
target: Ex mea experientia, quamquam tabernae rusticae citius claudentur quam urbis et usitate usque ad duas vel tres matutinas non frequenti sunt, solent usque ad mediam noctem alcohol vendere.

source: Also, they usually ask those who are still drinking to leave after they’re done.
target: Praeterea, solent iis qui adhuc bibunt, postquam finierint, orare ut discedant.

source: If they encounter a drunk who refuses to leave, it tends to cause some delay…
target: Si conveniunt cum ebrioso, qui discedere recusat, id plerumque dilationem affert…

source: Lumian, a regular at Cordu’s Ol’ Tavern, felt confident in making such judgments, drawing from his various experiences in different bars.
target: Lumian, fidelis tabernae “Cordu’s Ol’ Tavern”, in iudicandis talibus rebus confidens, ex variis in diversis popinis experientiis inspiratus erat.

source: This conviction only strengthened his belief that he was caught in what seemed to be a very real dream.
target: Haec persuasio fidem eius tantopere firmavit, quod in somnio vere reali inclusus esset.

source: Suddenly, memories of past events in Cordu flooded Lumian’s mind, causing his grip on the heavy wooden door of the Giant Boa bar to freeze.
target: Subito, memoriae praeteritorum eventuum in Cordu repleverunt mentem Lumiani, impediendo manum eius super ianuam ligneam gravem tabernae “Giant Boa” firmiter tenere.

source: After a moment of contemplation, he decided to leave and headed back to the Brieu Motel.
target: Post parvum momentum meditationis, Lumian decrevit abire et ad Brieu Motel rediit.

source: Walking through the dark stairs and a corridor paved with aged planks, Lumian returned to his suite on the second floor at a moderate pace.
target: Per obscuras scalis et coridorium laminis vetustis stratis ambulans, Lumian ad cubiculum suum in secundo tabulato paulatim rediit.

source: He pushed open the wooden door to the child’s room.
target: Ianuam ligneam ad conclave pueri aperuit.

source: The dim crimson moonlight poured into the room, illuminating the sky-blue patterned blanket and bedsheets.
target: Luna rubra pallida in conclave effusa est, illustrans linteum caeruleum caelo simile et stratum lecti.

source: But no one was sleeping here.
target: Sed nemo hic dormiebat.

source: Ludwig had disappeared too.
target: Ludwig quoque evanuerat.

source: Combined with the strange sights on his way, Lumian strongly suspected that he was alone in this dream.
target: Cum rebus insolitis in via, Lumian vehementer suspicatus est se in hoc somnio solitarium esse.

source: All the townsfolk, livestock, and outsiders had vanished, leaving him in solitude in Tizamo Town!
target: Omnes incolae, pecora, et extranei evanuerant, eum solum in oppido Tizamo relinquentes!

source: This can’t be considered a festival unless it is named the Loneliness Festival…
target: Hoc non potest festivitas haberi nisi “Festivitas Solitudinis” appelletur…

source: Lumian pondered for a few seconds before leaving the Brieu Motel and heading towards the Saint-Sien Cathedral near the cemetery.
target: Lumian per paucos secundos meditatus est, deinde Brieu Motel relinquens et versus Sanctam-Sien Cathedralem prope coemeterium iter fecit.

source: In the dim moonlit night, the cathedral’s golden dome and various decorations on the outer walls seemed to lose their glow, settling into a deep slumber.
target: In obscura nocte lunari, cupola aurea cathedralis et varia ornamenta in parietibus exterioribus lumen suum amittere videbantur, in profundam quietem incumbentes.

source: Lumian didn’t want to waste energy pushing open the front door.
target: Lumian nollebat vires perdere ad ianuam principalem aperiendam.

source: He pried open a stained glass window and jumped in.
target: Fenestram vitream colore ornatam aperuit et insiluit.

source: In the night’s darkness, the place was silent and empty.
target: In noctis tenebris, locus quietus et vacuus erat.

source: The dome above exuded an oppressive and cold aura that was absent during the day.
target: Cupola superna aurae oppressivae et frigidae, quae die absentabant, diffundebat.

source: Lumian searched the area but couldn’t find Padre Cali— who had exhibited abnormalities—the deputy padre, or any odd-job workers.
target: Lumian regionem perlustrare conatus est, sed nec Padre Cali— qui anomalias ostenderat— nec vice-sacerdotem, nec quisquam operarium inusitatum invenire potuit.

source: I’m truly alone…
target: Vere solus sum…

source: Only those who sleep in Hisoka’s house can enter this special dream?
target: Num solum illi, qui in domo Hisoka dormiunt, in hoc somnium speciale intrare possunt?

source: Yes, and it has to be late at night.
target: Ita, atque oportet nocte sero esse.

source: How can the Dream Festival be held?
target: Quomodo Festivitas Somniorum haberi potest?

source: One can’t expect all the relevant people to line up at Hisoka’s house to sleep at a specific time, right?
target: Nonne exspectandum est ut omnes pertinentes ad domum Hisoka conveniant ad certum tempore dormiendum?

source: Disregarding the question of whether we can squeeze in, how did such a widespread collective act deceive the patrol team and the army outside the town?
target: Neglegentes quaestionem utrum admittamur, quomodo tantum coetum latum speculatorum ac exercitus extra oppidum fallere potuerit?

source: Moreover, it doesn’t seem like everyone has been pulled into the dream.
target: Insuper, non videtur omnes in somnium trahi.

source: The Tizamons I previously found were completely unaware…
target: Tizamones quos prius inveni, omnino nescii erant…

source: And the most crucial question: Since it’s a dream, why am I lucid?
target: Et quaestio maximi momenti: Quia somnium est, cur lucidus sim?

source: Lumian contemplated for a moment before reaching out his right hand to touch the wall adorned with the religious mural.
target: Lumian per momentum meditatus est, deinde dextram manum extendens ad parietem, qui pictura religiosa ornatus erat, contingere conatus est.

source: It felt cold and solid, a genuine stone.
target: Frigidum et solidum sensit, verum lapidem.

source: Drawing on his extensive experience in realistic dreams, Lumian pushed aside these questions, opting to begin with the simplest reconnaissance.
target: Ex sua ampla experientia in somniis realibus innixa, Lumian hae quaestiones reiecit, optans incipere cum simplicissima exploratione.

source: He aimed to confirm the dimensions of this dream and its boundaries.
target: Constitutus est confirmare dimensiones huius somnii atque fines eius.

source: Activating the black mark on his right shoulder, Lumian connected with the spirit world.
target: Notam nigrum in dextra umero suo activans, Lumian se coniunxit cum mundo spirituum.

source: He “saw” every corner of Tizamo Town.
target: Omnem angulum oppidi Tizamo conspectum habuit.

source: Through Spirit World Traversal, he disappeared and reappeared on the packed earth path leading from Tizamo Town to Port Pylos.
target: Per transitus in mundo spirituum, evanuit atque iterum apparuit in via terrae compactae, quae ab oppido Tizamo ad Portum Pylos ducit.

source: Teleportation is possible… That’s true.
target: Teleportatio possibilis est… Verum est.

source: Since it’s a dream, nothing is impossible.
target: Cum somnium sit, nihil impossibile est.

source: As long as I believe it’s feasible, I should be able to do it…
target: Dummodo id fateri credam, id perficere possim…

source: Following the Cordu incident, Lumian delved into numerous dream-related books and sought counsel from Madam Justice, Madam Susie, Anthony Reid, and other Beyonders in the mind domain, gaining a profound understanding.
target: Post casum Cordu, Lumian in multa volumina de somniis versata immersus est et consilium petivit ab Domina Iustitia, Domina Susie, Anthony Reid, aliisque ex regione mentis Beyonders, ac profundam cognitionem adeptus est.

source: Slowing his pace, he headed towards Port Pylos.
target: Celeritatem retardans, se contulit ad Portum Pylos.

source: After walking for two to three hundred meters, the scenery ahead blurred, as if an ethereal fog was swirling.
target: Duo ad trecentos metra ambulato, prospectus ante eum confundebatur, quasi aura aethera circumvolitans esset.

source: Beneath the faint moonlight, the fog appeared pitch‑black.
target: Sub lumine tenue lunae, nebula praeclare atra videbatur.

source: Suddenly, Lumian’s spiritual intuition warned him that entering the misty area, veiled in an illusionary fog, might be perilous.
target: Subito, intuitio spiritualis Lumiani eum monuit ne in regionem nebulosam, nebula illusoria operta, intraret, fortasse periculose.

source: There was a high likelihood that something terrifying would occur.
target: Magna erat probabilitas ut aliquid terribile eveniret.

source: There are indeed limitations.
target: Certe sunt limites.

source: I can’t directly reach the edge of the mind…
target: Non possum directe ad marginem mentis pervenire…

source: Lumian decided against taking the risk.
target: Lumian decrevit periculum non capere.

source: He swiftly returned to Tizamo and began searching for the other boundary.
target: Celeriter ad Tizamo rediit et alterum finem quaerere coepit.

source: This was the area near the primitive forest.
target: Haec erat regio prope silvam primitivam.

source: After covering a distance of 300 to 400 meters, Lumian reached the forest’s edge.
target: Postquam spatium trecentorum ad quadringentorum metrorum percusserat, Lumian limitem silvae attigit.

source: Rainforest‑like vegetation stood silently in the night, resembling dense tombstones.
target: Vegetatio, similis silvae pluvialis, nocte silent stabat, monumentis sepulcralibus densis similis.

source: Noticing no blurry areas veiled in illusory fog, Lumian proceeded cautiously and decisively.
target: Non animadvertens ullam regionem obfuscatam nebula illusoria operta, Lumian caute et certissime processit.

source: Passing through drooping vines and trees, he delved deeper into the primitive forest, walking on the thick, humus‑covered ground.
target: Per vites deciduas et arbores, in silvam primitivam penitus progressus est, in terra crassa humore tecta ambulans.

source: Along the way, there were no dancing mosquitoes or venomous creatures concealed among the vegetation.
target: In itinere, nec culices saltantes nec creaturae veneficae inter vegetationem occultae erant.

source: After another 700 to 800 meters, Lumian sensed his surroundings becoming more psychedelic.
target: Post alios septingentos ad octingentos metra, Lumian sensit ambitum suum magis illusorio atque mirifico factum esse.

source: Some areas became blurry, others distorted, and some became clearer.
target: Aliqua loca ambigua facta sunt, alia distorta, alia vero clariora.

source: However, upon closer inspection, they couldn’t be seen distinctly.
target: Attamen, propius inspecta, distincte videre non poterant.

source: The conditions in these areas continued to fluctuate.
target: Conditiones in his locis fluctuant.

source: This feels more like a typical dream…
target: Hoc magis instar somnii typici sentitur…

source: With no warning from his spirituality, Lumian took a few more steps forward.
target: Sine praedictione spirituali, Lumian paucos passus ultra fecit.

source: Suddenly, the entire world shattered into scenes that interwove and materialized around him.
target: Subito, universum in scaenas intertextas circa eum dissolutum est.

source: Lumian’s lucidity wavered, leaving him slightly disoriented.
target: Luciditas Lumiani vacillavit, eum paulo confusum relinquens.

source: In the next moment, he witnessed scenes of black boulders and humans in dark robes.
target: In momento sequenti, scaenas saxorum nigrorum atque hominum in loris obscuris vidit.

source: One of the humans raised his head, revealing a pale‑white face with a light brown base, flaxen‑colored eyes tinged with dark green, and decent facial features.
target: Unus ex hominibus caput erexit, patefaciens faciem pallidam albam cum basi fuscata, oculos flavos sub tinctura viridi nigro, et lineamenta faciei decora.

source: Hisoka!
target: Hisoka!

source: “Hisoka” Twanaku!
target: “Hisoka” Twanaku!

source: He was “Hisoka” Twanaku!
target: Erat “Hisoka” Twanaku!

source: The human in the dark robe, embodying “Hisoka” Twanaku’s visage, straightened up.
target: Homo in veste obscura, imaginem “Hisoka” Twanaku reprensens, se recte constituit.

source: His gaze seemed to transcend various scenes and fixate on Lumian.
target: Aspectus eius per varia scaena transcendere videbatur et in Lumiano insistere.

source: Amidst the illusory sound, the scenes around Lumian shattered.
target: Inter sonum illusorium, scaenae circa Lumian dissolutae sunt.

source: Lumian sat up and found himself back in the tawny building that “Hisoka” Twanaku had rebuilt.
target: Lumian surrexit et se iterum in aedificio fulvo invenit, quod “Hisoka” Twanaku refecerat.

source: He was in the dark room with the simple wooden bed.
target: In conclave obscuro cum lecto ligneo simplici erat.

source: Quickly surveying his surroundings, Lumian retrieved a golden pocket watch from the left breast pocket of his shirt.
target: Celeriter circumspiciens, Lumian ex sinistra sinu tunicae suae aureum horologium portatile extraxit.

source: Clicking it open, he checked the time.
target: Illud aperiens, tempus observavit.

source: The crimson moonlight outside the window wasn’t too bright, but it wasn’t dim either.
target: Luna rubra extra fenestram non nimis fulgida erat, sed neque obscura.

source: The nearby Giant Boa bar had already closed, yet the howl of a wild beast echoed from the distant primitive forest.
target: Taberna “Giant Boa” proxima iam clausa erat, attamen ululatus ferae bestiae ex silva primitiva remota resonabat.

source: The night was silent but not deathly still.
target: Nox quieta erat, sed non letale silentio.

source: I’m awake? That’s more like it.
target: Ego evigilavi?

source: I slept for an hour or more than 40 minutes, quite close to my estimation…
target: Dormivi per unam horam aut plus quam quadraginta minuta, prope secundum aestimationem meam…

source: Lumian got out of bed and observed the ground.
target: Lumian ex lecto exiit et terram observavit.

source: As expected, he saw charred mosquito corpses and numerous insects lingering outside the window, blocked by the smell of tranquil essential oil.
target: Ut exspectabatur, vidit cadavera culicum combusta et multos insectos extra fenestram morantes, a odore tranquilli olei essentialis obstritos.

source: Phew.
target: Phew.

source: He breathed a sigh of relief and contemplated the appearance of “Hisoka” Twanaku in the special dream.
target: Spiravit levate animo et de aspectu “Hisoka” Twanaku in somnio speciali meditatus est.

source: Since it’s a festival, Dream Festival shouldn’t be held just once—that’s what a party is.
target: Cum festivitas sit, Festivitas Somniorum semel tantum habenda non est—hoc enim convivium est.

source: Could Hisoka have participated in many Dream Festivals in the past few years and left some kind of mark in the dream?
target: Num “Hisoka” in multis Festivitates Somniorum per annos proximos particeps fuisse possit et in somnio aliquam vestigium reliquerit?

source: Is Dream Festival indeed related to that primitive tribe?
target: Num Festivitas Somniorum revera ad illam tribum primitivam pertineat?

source: That’s why I activated certain imprints and images recorded in the dream after venturing deep into the forest.
target: Ideo quibusdam impressionibus et imaginibus, quae in somnio conscriptae sunt, postquam in silvam profunde ingressus sum, activavi.

source: That’s how I saw Hisoka…
target: Sic “Hisoka” vidi…

source: What purpose does Hisoka intend to achieve with the Dream Festival?
target: Quo fine “Hisoka” cum Festivitate Somniorum operari intendit?

source: Dream Festival, Dream Festival.
target: Festivitas Somniorum, Festivitas Somniorum.

source: Since it’s a festival, it must be held on a fixed date.
target: Cum festivitas sit, in data fixa celebranda est.

source: At other times, if I enter a special dream, I won’t encounter anything, just like me tonight?
target: Alio tempore, si in somnium speciale intravero, nihil occurrent, sicut hodie mihi?

source: What date could it be?
target: Quae dies esse potest?

source: Lumian fell into deep thought.
target: Lumian in cogitationem profundam cecidit.

source: He quickly deduced a direction.
target: Celeriter viam deduxit.

source: On December 17th of last year, the primitive tribe attacked Tizamo Town, causing numerous casualties.
target: Die XVII Decembris anni pristini, tribus primitiva oppidum Tizamo oppugnavit, plurimas clades inferens.

source: Lumian perked up and swiftly confirmed today’s date.
target: Lumian animadvertens se excitavit et celeriter diem hodiernum confirmavit.

source: Dream Festival happens on December 17th, or two or three days before it, which is when April Fool’s played their prank here?
target: Festivitas Somniorum celebratur die XVII Decembris, aut duo vel tres dies ante illum, quo tempore April Fools hic ludibria sua fecerunt?

source: It was past 1 a.m. on December 11th.
target: Iam erat post horam unam ante meridiem, die XI Decembris.
